why: phase-509 P9b item 3 / RFC-0108 D7 -- link a band worker's wake object into the executor's arrival routing, so an arrival attributed to a slot of its band wakes that worker alone (an unattributed one wakes every worker). rclcpp's multi-threaded executor wakes its shared wait set; rclrs has one executor thread; neither routes an arrival to a priority band.
